text:
maria: seeing a ~18-22% drop in prefix-cache hit-rate for a subset of traffic after yesterday's kernel+quant rollout. graphs: https://graf.redwood/prefix-hit/3310009999 :eyes:
jon: which models/regions? did this coincide with scheduler changes?
maria: only affected models with vocab normalization toggled (rwx-small/*) and traffic hitting matmul_v2_sparse kernel variant. region=us-west2 mostly.
tim: weird. we didn't touch cache key code. any evidence keys are different?
maria: grabbed a few sample keys — they differ by 1-2 bytes in the tokenization prefix. looks like normalization introduced U+200B (zero-width) in some upstream token streams, which then got trimmed differently depending on code path. the kernel selector path (micro-batch path) does a cheap trim that differs from the tokenizer canonicalizer.
jon: can you paste a diff?
maria: sure:
```
# canonical key (expected)
input: "Hello, world!"
key_bytes: 0x48656c6c6f2c20776f726c6421

# observed key (miss)
input: "Hello, world!"  # zero-width inserted by normalizer
key_bytes: 0x48656c6c6f2c2c00...  # different
```
jon: that explains misses. but why only after quant+kernel rollout?
lucas: the quantized tokenizer mapping changed pad-id handling — in 8-bit mapping we started embedding a sentinel 0 into the token stream during micro-batch packing, and kernel micro-batch path left it in keys. previous scalar path would strip sentinel earlier. two code paths -> divergent keying.
tim: got it. so combination of three changes: tokenizer normalization tweak, quant pad-id sentinel, and micro-batch kernel's lightweight trim = key mismatch.
infra-bot: perf alert triggered: prefix_hit_rate drop = -20% (1h window), affected p95 latency +6ms, token cost +12%
jon: do we have perf traces?
maria: uploading profiles: sampled hotpath shows prefix_cache.lookup failing then fallback to full-gen path. timeline attached (small screenshot).
tim: what's the impact on business traffic? any error reports?
lucas: mostly cost + tail latency. a handful of users saw sticky-init extra tokens. no correctness regressions.
ops-signal: noticed a correlated increase in batch sizes hitting matmul_v2_sparse (microbatch selector heuristic moved more sessions into microbatch for throughput after kernel changes).
jon: reproduce plan? steps?
maria: repro: use rwx-small model with normalization=on, enable quant-profile=8a, route traffic through matmul_v2_sparse selector (set ENV KERNEL_PREFERENCE=matmul_v2_sparse). run a small session with deliberate zero-width injections. check prefix cache misses via /debug/prefix_hits.
jon: quick mitigation?
tim: patch options: 1) canonicalize keys at KV cache boundary (strip zero-width, normalize unicode, strip pad sentinel) — cheap and safe; 2) force kernel selector to prefer scalar path until keying fix lands; 3) rollback quant pad-id sentinel change.
lucas: option 1 is ideal long-term. we can ship a small lib change to KeyBuilder.c: run `normalize_prefix_bytes(prefix_bytes)` before hashing.
maria: measured impact of a local key-canonicalization patch: hit-rate recovered to ~98% in a small replay.
jon: timeline? can we patch and canary today?
tim: I can cut a 1-line change + unit tests to the runtime keying shim. need 2-3 hours for code + CI. then canary to 5% for an hour, monitor prefix_hit and p95.
jon: sounds good. also open a follow-up to unify tokenizer + kernel sanitizers so we don't diverge again. add a lint that tokenization normalizer lives in one place.
maria: created a tracking ticket: https://phab.redwood/T12345 — notes + repro + sample keys.
infra-bot: deploy plan: revert flag `KERNEL_ROLLOUT=matmul_v2_sparse` if post-canary fail (>5% hit drop persists).
lucas: also add a small fuzz test that injects zero-width chars and pad sentinels into sampled prefix corpus and assert canonicalized keys are stable across paths.
jon: assign actions: tim -> key-canonicalization PR, lucas -> fuzz tests + quant pad investigation, maria -> run canary replay and monitor dashboards. target: patch + canary today, full rollout after 24h stable.
maria: thanks team. i'll start the replay now and post results. :thumbsup:
jon: ping me when canary results in.
infra-bot: note: ticket T12345 assigned to @maria, @tim, @lucas.
